name: Prof. Dr. Isabelle Borucki
intro: I study how digital transformation reshapes democracy, political parties, and the ways we participate.
about: I am Professor for Methodology and Democracy in Digital Transformation at Philipps-University Marburg. My research connects political organizations and comparative politics with digitalization, political communication, and methodological integration.
